name: hwcloud-dms
title: Huawei Distributed Message Service (DMS)
description: To integrate with a fully managed, high-performance message queuing service on Huawei Cloud
label: cloud

properties.name: operation
properties.label: producer
properties.description: Operation to be performed

properties.name: accessKey
properties.description: Access key for the cloud user

properties.name: accessUser
properties.description: The username of a RabbitMQ instance. This option is mandatory when creating a RabbitMQ instance.

properties.name: availableZones
properties.description: A comma separated String of Availability Zones. This option is mandatory when creating an instance and it cannot be an empty array.

properties.name: endpoint
properties.description: DMS url. Carries higher precedence than region parameter based client initialization

properties.name: engine
properties.description: The message engine. Either kafka or rabbitmq. If the parameter is not specified, all instances will be queried

properties.name: engineVersion
properties.description: The version of the message engine. This option is mandatory when creating an instance.

properties.name: instanceId
properties.description: The id of the instance. This option is mandatory when deleting or querying an instance

properties.name: kafkaManagerPassword
properties.description: The password for logging in to the Kafka Manager. This option is mandatory when creating a Kafka instance.

properties.name: kafkaManagerUser
properties.description: The username for logging in to the Kafka Manager. This option is mandatory when creating a Kafka instance.

properties.name: name
properties.description: The name of the instance for creating and updating an instance. This option is mandatory when creating an instance

properties.name: partitionNum
properties.description: The maximum number of partitions in a Kafka instance. This option is mandatory when creating a Kafka instance.

properties.name: password
properties.description: The password of a RabbitMQ instance. This option is mandatory when creating a RabbitMQ instance.

properties.name: productId
properties.description: The product ID. This option is mandatory when creating an instance.

properties.name: projectId
properties.description: Cloud project ID

properties.name: proxyHost
properties.description: Proxy server ip/hostname

properties.name: proxyPassword
properties.description: Proxy authentication password

properties.name: proxyPort
properties.description: Proxy server port

properties.name: proxyUser
properties.description: Proxy authentication user

properties.name: region
properties.description: DMS service region

properties.name: secretKey
properties.description: Secret key for the cloud user

properties.name: securityGroupId
properties.description: The security group which the instance belongs to. This option is mandatory when creating an instance.

properties.name: serviceKeys
properties.description: Configuration object for cloud service authentication

properties.name: specification
properties.description: The baseline bandwidth of a Kafka instance. This option is mandatory when creating a Kafka instance.

properties.name: storageSpace
properties.description: The message storage space. This option is mandatory when creating an instance.

properties.name: storageSpecCode
properties.description: The storage I/O specification. This option is mandatory when creating an instance.

properties.name: subnetId
properties.description: The subnet ID. This option is mandatory when creating an instance.

properties.name: vpcId
properties.description: The VPC ID. This option is mandatory when creating an instance.

properties.name: lazyStartProducer
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

properties.name: ignoreSslVerification
properties.label: security
properties.description: Ignore SSL verification
